column1: # Per-tool crate counts in the shipped store, written by build-tool-crate-store.sh.
# 0 means the tool contributed NOTHING -- it was skipped (no lock, clone or sync
# failure). The build still exits 0 in that case, so this file is the record that
# makes it visible. Gated by: build/verify-crate-store --check-coverage
# Format: <name>\t<crates>.  00-seeds is the curated user closure, not a tool.
